usageNote: 动词短语！spend time with就是'陪伴某人/某物'，超万能！换个动物或人都能用，记住这个句型赚大了！

examples.en: She got to spend time with the dolphins during her Hawaii vacation.
examples.zh: 她在夏威夷度假期间有机会与海豚共度时光。

examples.en: The kids were thrilled to spend time with the dolphins at the marine park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在海洋公园里与海豚相处，兴奋极了。
